summary: Wide parking strip between bushland and a park; homes 70 m or more away.
reasons: Bush on one side, park on the other
Many cars and vans parked here

best_section.where: Wide road-edge parking strip beside the park, at the pin

drivers.seclusion: Forest to the north, open park to the south; houses 74 m or more away across the park.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed strip where many vehicles park nose to tail, with plenty of room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side strip, set well back from the main road to the south.
drivers.convention: Rows of cars, white vans and motorhome-style vehicles park here, so a van won't stand out.

flags: Markets or event parking: crowded at times
Pin sits on the road itself, not a marked bay
Nearby main road gives some noise
sun_shade: Shaded by bush from the north and morning trees; open to the west in the afternoon.
cannot_judge: Time limits or signs on site
